interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] [b]Three bags of ice[/b], please. My drinks are warm already.

response_choices: Busy at the drinks stall, Thu?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] Good morning for sales. Bad morning for gossip. Hanh told everyone Binh had not paid her.
[color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] I paid her too. Now I am wondering whether I should ask to see my line in that book.
[color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] Thanks. Three bags should get me through the afternoon.
